newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore November CPI up 1.4 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore November CPI up 1.4 pct on year.

text.p: Singapore's consumer price index (CPI) was up 1.4 percent in November from the same month last year and 0.2 percent up over October, the Department of Statistics said on Monday
In October, the CPI was 1.4 percent higher than in the same month of the previous year and unchanged over September.

Note - In November year-on-year food rose 2.2 percent, clothing was unchanged, housing rose 0.9, transport and communication rose 0.1, education rose 2.6, health rose 2.7 and miscellaneous rose by 2.0.
